name: consent-01
title: Consent 01 - A Notice With Two Peers And No Memory
description: A cookie and tracking notice with a filled accept beside an outlined reject of the same size, a quieter settings route, and a link to the caller's own policy. Reject and accept are peers because a notice whose reject is a ghost beside a filled accept is a dark pattern this design system would have shipped the styling for. Both handlers are required, so no arm of the Block shows a reader a notice they cannot refuse, and the Block persists nothing, so the stored decision and its consequences are the consumer's. Every string is passed in as a prop.
